title: Assets and Liabilities
introduction: Explore assets and liabilities using everyday examples.
definition: An asset is something of economic value owned or controlled; a liability is an obligation such as debt. Net worth in a simple example is total assets minus total liabilities. Assets can change in value.

exercises.question: Assets RM800, liabilities RM250. Net worth?
Savings RM300 and bicycle value RM200. Total assets?
Asset falls from RM500 to RM400. Decline?
Assets RM2,400, liabilities RM900. Net worth?
Is an unpaid loan a liability? yes/no

summary: An asset is something of economic value owned or controlled; a liability is an obligation such as debt. Net worth in a simple example is total assets minus total liabilities. Assets can change in value.
